## Platform Upgrade Result
Branch: support/R1-403-upgrade-platform
MR URL: https://github.com/torchbox/rca-wagtail-2019/pull/1205
Outcome: success
Notes: Python 3.13 → 3.15, Node 24 → 26, Debian stayed trixie (no-op). Sub-agent fixed a pillow-heif/cp315 wheel gap and a .pre-commit-config.yaml python-version pin, documented the pillow-heif gotcha in docs/upgrading.md, self-reviewed, pushed and opened the sub-MR — but was cut off before its CI pipeline finished and reported Outcome: partial with the pipeline still pending. The orchestrator independently verified the sub-MR's pipeline (tbx-support mr pipeline can't read GitHub pipelines; gh pr checks 1205 used instead) and found lint-python red: lxml 6.1.1 (the locked version) ships no cp315 wheel at all and fails compiling from source in CI (missing libxml2/libxslt dev headers). Fixed on the sub-MR's own branch by relocking lxml to 6.1.3 (within the existing ~6.1 constraint, confirmed to ship cp315 wheels), verified only lxml moved in poetry.lock, rebuilt, and ran the full test suite (289 tests, all green) before committing and pushing. All three GitHub Actions jobs (lint-front-end, lint-python, test/python-tests) are now green on head 480ddeb9. One item to carry into the Python bump phase: the test run surfaced a RemovedInWagtail80Warning for construct_wagtail_userbar hooks in both wagtail_personalisation.wagtail_hooks and the project's own rca.personalisation.wagtail_hooks.remove_personalisation_segments (the fragile hook docs/upgrading.md already flags) — this becomes a hard break once Wagtail lands on 8.1, so it needs fixing during the Wagtail bump, not deferred.
